cfg.url: The Emkay to run your skill in. `https://app.emkay.ai/` is the newest build; an Emkay served from your house (Emkay Home) or `http://localhost:8080/` work too. Emkay is opened with `?dev`.
cfg.reloadOnSave: Run the skill again in Emkay each time you save one of its files.
cfg.busLog: Also show every message on Emkay's bus (the "Emkay bus" output). Handy to see exactly what happens; a lot of text.
walk.title: Make your first voice skill
walk.description: From nothing to Emkay answering you, in four small steps – no installing, it all runs here.
walk.new.title: Make a skill
walk.new.description:
A skill is a few small files: the sentences you say, what Emkay answers, and a little Python.
[Make a skill](command:emkay.newSkill)
walk.run.title: Run it in Emkay
walk.run.description:
Emkay opens next to your code and loads your skill. After this, every save runs the new version.
[Run it](command:emkay.run)
walk.say.title: Talk to it
walk.say.description:
Type what you would say – "hello from my skill" – and hear Emkay answer.
[Say something](command:emkay.say)
walk.test.title: Test it
walk.test.description:
The test sentences in test/end2end/ are sent to Emkay one by one; each must reach your skill. The same tests the Emkay store and ovos-tui-client run.
[Test it](command:emkay.test)
cfg.templates: Where *Emkay: New skill* finds its templates (`index.json` and one file per template). Made by [emkay-voice/dev](https://github.com/emkay-voice/dev) from its `templates.json`.
